blogs.title: Tasty Cantonese Chicken Recipe
blogs.content:
Cantonese chicken is one of the easiest chicken you could ever make. It tastes delicious with rice, noodles or fried rice. It is sweet and salty and tastes so delicious.

I tasted this chicken in a restaurant and it was served over a bed of rice. I enjoyed it so much, I thought of recreating it at home. I searched online and the recipe was pretty simple and basic.

 

Cantonese Chicken Recipe

Prep time: 5 mins

Cook time: 15 mins

Total time: 20 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Chinese

Serves: 2 to 3 servings

 

Ingredients

Boneless Chicken - 500 grams

Oyster Sauce - 2 tablespoons

Dark Soy Sauce - 1 tablespoon

Vinegar - 1 teaspoon

Sugar - 1 tablespoon

Salt to taste

Oil - 2 tablespoons

Garlic - 1 tablespoon chopped finely

Ginger - 1 tablespoon chopped finely

Onion - ½ cup chopped finely

Chicken Stock or Water - 1 cup

Cornflour / Cornstarch - 1 tablespoon

 

Instructions

Take chicken, soy sauce, oyster sauce, sugar, salt, and vinegar in a bowl and mix well.

Heat oil in a pan, add ginger, garlic, and onions. Saute for a min.

Add in the chicken and stir fry for 2 mins.

Add in chicken stock and bring it to a boil. Simmer for 5 mins.

Now add in cornflour which is mixed with water into this. Stir well. Cook till it is thickened as per your liking.

Serve it over rice.

blogs.title: Tasty Methi ( Fenugreek Leaves ) Chicken Recipe
blogs.title_hi: टेस्टी मेथी (मेथी की पत्तियां) चिकन रेसिपी
blogs.content:
A super fragrant and tasty chicken dish made using methi leaves. This chicken dish tastes great with rice, roti, phulka as well.

When I was looking for dinner inspiration online, I came across a picture of a spicy chicken curry served with some naan. I got so inspired by that so I made it almost immediately.

This chicken dish is so easy to make, you don't need coconut or any other kinds of stuff. If you use larger chicken pieces then it will be tastier. I used small cut chicken because of what I had on hand.

 

Methi Chicken Recipe - Fenugreek Leaves Chicken Curry Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 30 mins

Total time: 40 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 4 servings

 

Ingredients

Oil - 4 tablespoons

Shahi Jeera - 1 teaspoon

Onion - 2 large chopped finely

Ginger Garlic Paste - 1 tablespoon

Green Chilli - 2 slit

Tomato - 3 pureed

Chicken - 500 grams

Chilli powder - 2 teaspoons

Kashmiri Chilli Powder - 1 tablespoon

Turmeric Powder - 1 teaspoon

Cumin Powder - 1 teaspoon

Coriander Powder - 2 teaspoon

Garam Masala Powder - 1 teaspoon

Kasuri Methi Leaves - ½ cup

Yogurt - ½ cup

Coriander leaves a handful chopped finely

Salt to taste

 

Instructions

Heat oil in a pan, add shahi jeera.

Add onions and cook till golden brown.

Add in ginger garlic paste and chilies. Saute for a min.

Add in the tomato puree and cook till oil separates.

Add in chicken and stir well

Add in salt and spice powders and mix well.

Add water and cook chicken for 15 to 20 mins.

Now add in whisked yogurt and mix well.

Simmer for 10 mins.

Add in methi leaves and mix well.

Add in garam masala powder and coriander leaves and mix well.

Serve it.

blogs.title: Tasty Methi Malai Chicken Recipe
blogs.content:
Delicious and creamy methi malai chicken which tastes great with rice or roti. This gravy goes perfect with pulao as well.

When I was looking for dinner inspiration online, I came across a picture of a spicy chicken curry served with some naan. I got so inspired by that so I made it almost immediately.

This chicken dish is so easy to make, you don't need coconut or any other kinds of stuff. If you use larger chicken pieces then it will be tastier. I used small cut chicken because of what I had on hand.

 

Methi Malai Chicken Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 40 mins

Total time: 50 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 3 servings

 

Ingredients

Oil - 3 tablespoons

Cumin Seeds / Shahi Jeera - 1 teaspoon

Onion - 2 chopped finely

Ginger Garlic paste - 1 tablespoon

Green Chillies - 4 slit

Chicken - 500 grams

Salt to taste

Yogurt / Curd - 1 cup

Garam Masala Powder - 2 teaspoons

Pepper Powder - 2 teaspoons

Kasuri Methi Leaves - ¼ cup

Fresh Cream - ½ cup

 

Instructions

Heat oil in a pan. Add in shahi jeera and let it sizzle.

Add in onions, cook till golden.

Add in ginger garlic paste, green chilies and mix well.

Add in chicken and mix well.

Add in salt, turmeric and mix well.

Add in yogurt and mix well. Cover and cook till chicken is done.

Add in pepper powder, garam masala powder and mix well.

Add in cream and mix well.

Take it off the heat and serve it.

blogs.title: Tasty Dry Roasted Chicken ( Chicken Peratal ) Recipe
blogs.title_hi: टेस्टी ड्राई रोस्टेड चिकन (चिकन परताल) रेसिपी
blogs.content:
A super delicious chicken dish that not only tastes really delicious. But is very easy to make too. This goes great with rice, rasam or curd rice.

When I was looking for dinner inspiration online, I came across a picture of a spicy chicken curry served with some naan. I got so inspired by that so I made it almost immediately.

 

Chicken Peratal Recipe

Prep time: 5 mins

Cook time: 35 mins

Total time: 40 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 4 servings

 

Ingredients

Coconut Oil - ¼ cup

Shallots / Sambar Onion - 10 to 15

Coconut - ¼ cup grated

Garam Masala Powder - 1 teaspoon

Coriander leaves - a handful finely chopped

Lemon Juice - to taste

 

FOR MARINATION:

Chicken - 500 grams

Ginger - 1 tablespoon chopped finely

Garlic - 2 tablespoons chopped finely

Onion - 1 large sliced thinly

Curry leaves - 1 sprig

Curd - ¼ cup

Salt to taste

 

FOR ROASTING:

Kashmiri Chilli powder - 1 tablespoon

Chilli powder - 2 teaspoons

Turmeric Powder - ½ teaspoon

Coriander Powder - 1 tablespoon

 

Instructions

Dry roast spice powders for 2 mins. Take it in a bowl with onions and mix well. Add all the ingredients and mix well. Leave aside for 20 mins.

Take it in a pan, mix well. Cover with a lid and cook on low heat for 20 mins.

Now add in oil and mix well. Add in shallots and mix well.

Cook till the chicken is well browned.

Add in coconut, garam masala and mix well.

Add in coriander leaves and lemon juice and mix well.

Serve it.

blogs.title: Tasty Manchatti Chicken Masala Recipe
blogs.content:
Spicy and flavourful manchatti chicken masala which tastes super delicious with rice, roti or naan. This is so easy to make and taste amazing.

When I was looking for dinner inspiration online, I came across a picture of a spicy chicken curry served with some naan. I got so inspired by that so I made it almost immediately.

 

Manchatti Chicken Masala Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 45 mins

Total time: 55 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 4 servings

 

Ingredients

Chicken - 500 grams

Coconut Oil - 4 tablespoons

Onions - 2 large sliced thinly

Green Chillies - 2

Ginger Garlic Paste - 2 tablespoons

Kashmiri Chilli Powder - 1 tablespoon

Coriander Powder - 1 tablespoon

Chicken Masala Powder - 2 tablespoons

Tomato - 4 large chopped finely

Curry Leaves a handful

Water as needed

Salt to taste

Coriander Leaves - a handful chopped finely

 

Instructions

Heat oil in a pot.

Add in onions, chilies and cook till golden.

Add in ginger garlic paste and saute for a min.

Add in tomatoes and cook till mushy.

Add in spice powders and mix well.

Add in salt and mix well.

Add in chicken, curry leaves and mix well.

Cover and cook on low heat till chicken is done.

Add in water and bring it to a boil. Simmer for 10 mins.

Add coriander leaves.

Serve it.

blogs.title: Tasty Palakkad Chicken Curry Recipe
blogs.content:
Super simple but delicious chicken curry made Palakkad style using shallots, onions and fresh masala. This deep coloured chicken curry not only tastes amazing but is easy to make as well.

This is a simple chicken curry made using fresh spices and shallots. The masala is darker in colour which gives the curry a deep rich colour.

 

 

Palakkad Chicken Curry Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 45 mins

Total time: 55 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 4 servings

 

Ingredients

Chicken - 1 kg bone-in and cut into small pieces

Turmeric Powder - 1 tsp

Salt to taste

 

FOR ROASTING & GRINDING:

Shallots / Sambar Onion - 15

Dry Red Chillies - 5 to 6

Coriander powder - 3 tablespoons

Red Chilli Powder - 1 tablespoon

Cumin powder - 2 teaspoon

Garam Masala Powder - 1 tablespoon

Turmeric Powder - 1 teaspoon

Coconut Oil - 1 tablespoon+ 3 tablespoon

Onion - 2 large sliced thinly

Curry Leaves a handful

Ginger Garlic paste - 2 tablespoon

Lemon Juice - to taste

Coriander Leaves a handful chopped finely

Curry leaves a sprig

Salt to taste

 

Instructions

Take chicken in a bowl add salt and turmeric and mix well. leave to marinate for 30 mins.

Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a Kadai. Add in shallots and dry red chillies and fry for 3 mins. Remove to a blender.

Now in the same Kadai. Add in spice powders and toast them for 2 to 3 mins.

Remove to the same blender and puree till smooth.

Heat more oil in the Kadai. Add in onions and curry leaves and cook till golden.

Add in ginger garlic paste and mix well.

Add in chicken and mix well.

Cover and cook the chicken till it is half done.

Add in the ground masala and mix well. Cover again and cook for 10 to 15 mins on low flame.

Turn off the heat and add in lemon juice, curry leaves and coriander leaves. Mix well.

Serve it.

blogs.title: Tasty Charcoal Grilled Chicken Recipe
blogs.content:
Delicious and moist grilled chicken which tastes so delicious and it is a fun recipe to try with your friends and family.

The chicken is so flavourful and tastes so juicy. The chicken outside has a nice crust in them from the charcoal and the inside is so juicy. This tastes amazing with some mayonnaise or garlic sauce.

 

Charcoal Grilled Chicken Recipe

Prep time: 15 mins

Cook time: 40 mins

Total time: 55 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 4 servings

 

Ingredients

Chicken 1 whole chicken cut into 10 pieces

Onion - 1 large chopped roughly

Garlic - 10 cloves

Chilli powder -1 tablespoon

Pepper Powder -1 tablespoon

Cumin powder - 1 tablespoon

Red Chilli flakes - 2 tablespoons

Sugar - 1 tablespoon

Salt to taste

Lemon Juice or Vinegar - ¼ cup

Oil - ¼ cup

Oregano - 1 tablespoon

Cayenne pepper powder - 1 teaspoon

 

Instructions

Take all ingredients in a blender except oil and chicken.

Grind to a smooth paste.

Take it in a large bowl, add oil and mix well.

Put the chicken in the marinade and mix well.

Leave to marinate for at least 4 to 6 hours. overnight is best.

Cook on a charcoal grill till done.

Serve it.

blogs.title: Tasty Cream Cheese Chicken Roll Recipe
blogs.title_hi: स्वादिष्ट क्रीम पनीर चिकन रोल पकाने की विधि
blogs.content:
Cream Cheese Chicken Roll-Ups Recipe taste so delicious and is pretty easy to make as well. This makes a great party snack or appetizer as well.

 

Cream Cheese Chicken Roll-Ups Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Total time: 10 mins

 

Cream Cheese Chicken Roll-Ups Recipe taste so delicious and is pretty easy to make as well. This makes a great party snack or appetizer as well.

Author: Aarthi

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: American

Serves: 2 servings

 

Ingredients

Tortilla or Leftover Roti - 2

Cream Cheese - ½ cup

Salt to taste

Pepper to taste

Onion - ¼ cup chopped finely

Capsicum - ¼ cup chopped finely

Leftover Cooked Chicken - 2 cups shredded

Instructions

Mix all ingredients except roti. Spread over tortilla or roti.

Roll it tight.

Cut it into pieces and serve it.

blogs.title: Tasty Chicken Yakhni Pulao Recipe
blogs.content:
A flavourful chicken pulao which is packed with aroma and is so delicious with some raita and salad. Taste so delicious.

Pulao or biryani comes handy when coming to lunch box recipes. This recipe goes perfect with some raita, I served it with onion raita. You can enjoy yourself with any raita of choice. You will need a handful of ingredients to make this pulao and it comes together in less than 40 mins.

 

Chicken Yakhni Pulao Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 45 mins

Total time: 55 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 6 to 8 servings

 

Ingredients

FOR COOKING CHICKEN:

Chicken - 1 kg with bones

Water - 5 cups

Shahi Jeera - 2 teaspoon

Cardamom / Yelakai - 5

Cloves / Krambu - 5

Bay Leaf - 1

Cinnamon / Pattai - 1 stick

Star Anise - 1

Salt to taste

Garam Masala Powder - 2 teaspoons

 

FOR BIRYANI:

Oil - ½ cup

Cumin Seeds / Jeerakam - ½ teaspoon

Cardamom/ Yelakai - 4

Cloves / Krambu - 4

Cinnamon / Pattai - 1 stick

Mace - 2 piece

Kalpassi - 1 piece

Onion - 2 large sliced thinly

Curd / Yogurt - ½ cup

Green Chilli - 5 to 6

Ginger Garlic paste - 2 tablespoon

Basmati Rice- 3 cups

Chicken Stock - 4.5 cup

Salt to taste

Kewra Water - ½ teaspoon

 

Instructions

Soak basmati rice for 30 mins.

Take the chicken and all spices in a large pot. Boil for 20 mins. Strain it and set aside.

Heat oil in a pot. Add in whole spices and let them fry.

Add in onions and chilies and fry till golden.

Add in ginger garlic paste and saute till raw smell leaves.

Add in curd and mix well.

Add in chicken and toss well.

Add in rice and mix well.

Add chicken stock and salt. Mix well.

Bring it to a boil. Cover and simmer for 15 to 20 mins.

Turn off the heat and let it stand for 10 mins.

Fork through the rice and serve it.

blogs.title: Tasty Grilled Chicken Salad With Ranch Dressing Recipe
blogs.title_hi: रेंच ड्रेसिंग रेसिपी के साथ टेस्टी ग्रिल्ड चिकन सलाद
blogs.content:
Creamy and flavourful dressing made using mayo and buttermilk. This dressing tastes amazing with plain iceberg lettuce or over any salad.

A delicious salad made using lettuce and chicken. The salad gets a new dimension of taste with homemade ranch dressing. This plate of chicken salad taste so delicious and is very easy to make as well.

 

Grilled Chicken Salad with Ranch Dressing

Prep time: 5 mins

Total time: 5 mins

 

Recipe type: Salad

Cuisine: American

Serves: 1 serving

 

Ingredients

Lettuce - as needed

Tomato - 1 cubed

Cucumber - ¼ cup cubed

Bell Pepper - ¼ cup cubed

Grilled Chicken as needed

Homemade Ranch Dressing as needed

 

Instructions

Take everything on a serving plate.

Pour dressing over.

Serve it.

blogs.title: Tasty Chicken Satay  Recipe
blogs.content:
Chicken satay tastes so deliciously hot, it is a Thai dish and taste so nutty and tasty. The chicken turned out so juicy and moist.

I recently tried this and I was kind of addicted to it because it turned out to be very delicious. It was spicy and juicy and smoky, everything you want a kebab to be.

 

Chicken Satay Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 20 mins

Total time: 30 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Thailand

Serves: 4 servings

 

Ingredients

Boneless Chicken - 500 grams

Garlic - 6 cloves chopped finely

Peanut Butter - ¼ cup

Soy Sauce - 1 tablespoon

Salt to taste

Black pepper - 1 teaspoon

Red Chilli Flakes - 1 teaspoon

Lemon Juice - 2 tablespoons

 

Instructions

Mix all ingredients in a bowl. Add in chicken and mix well.

Marinate for 30 mins.

Skewer the chicken and cook on a pan on both sides till done.

Serve it with cucumber.

blogs.title: Tasty Baked Ranch Chicken Recipe
blogs.content:
Baked Ranch Chicken Recipe with step wise pictures. Delicious ranch baked chicken which tastes so delicious and is so juicy. The chicken makes a great snack.

I recently tried this and I was kind of addicted to it because it turned out to be very delicious. It was spicy and juicy and smoky, everything you want to be.

 

Baked Ranch Chicken Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 20 mins

Total time: 30 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: American

Serves: 2 servings

 

Ingredients

Boneless Chicken - 300 grams

Ranch Dressing - ½ cup

Bread Crumbs - 1 cup

Italian Seasoning - 1 tablespoon

Salt to taste

 

Instructions

Take chicken in a bowl, add in ranch dressing and mix well. Leave to marinate for 30 mins.

Mix breadcrumbs with Italian seasoning and salt.\

Coat chicken in the breadcrumbs and arrange in a baking tray.

Preheat oven to 220 degrees C.

Bake this for 15 to 20 mins.

Remove and serve it.

blogs.title: Tasty Palak ( Pasalai Keerai ) Chicken Recipe
blogs.content:
Palak chicken tastes so delicious and is very easy to make as well. The creamy palak puree gives a nice taste to the whole dish.

This is a simple chicken curry made using fresh spices and spinach puree. This chicken dish is so easy to make, you need basic ingredients. If you use small chicken pieces then it will be tastier.

 

Palak Chicken Recipe - Pasalai Keerai Chicken Curry

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 30 mins

Total time: 40 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 4 servings

 

Ingredients

Oil - 3 tablespoons

Ghee - 3 tablespoons

Cumin Seeds / Jeerakam - 1 tsp

Cinnamon / Pattai - 1 stick

Cardamom / Yelakai - 4

Onion - 1 large chopped very finely

Tomato - 2 large chopped very finely

Chicken - 500 grams cubed

Palak - 2 cups puree

Chilli Powder - 2 teaspoon

Coriander Powder - 1 tablespoon

Cumin powder - 1 teaspoon

Garam masala powder - 1 teaspoon

Salt to taste

Dried Fenugreek Leaves / Kasuri methi leaves - 1 tablespoon

 

Instructions

Heat oil in a pan. Add in whole spices and let them sizzle.

Add in onions and cook for 5 mins.

Add in tomatoes and cook till mushy.

Add in chicken and sear for few mins.

Add in spice powders, salt and mix well.

Add in palak puree and mix well.

Add little water and cover and cook for 15 mins.

Add fenugreek leaves and mix well.

Serve it.

blogs.title: Tasty Mediterranean Grilled Chicken Recipe
blogs.title_hi: स्वादिष्ट भूमध्यसागरीय ग्रील्ड चिकन पकाने की विधि
blogs.content:
Finger licking grilled chicken with Mediterranean flavors. The lemon juice, oregano adds a nice taste to the chicken.

The chicken is so flavourful and tastes so juicy. The chicken outside has a nice crust in them from the charcoal and the inside is so juicy. This tastes amazing with some mayonnaise or garlic sauce.

 

Mediterranean Grilled Chicken Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 40 mins

Total time: 50 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Italian

Serves: 4 servings

 

Ingredients

Chicken - 1 whole chicken cut into segments

Onion - 1 large pureed

Red Chilli Flakes - 2 tablespoons

Oregano - 2 teaspoon

Black Pepper Powder - 2 teaspoon

Honey - 3 to 4 tablespoons

Salt to taste

Lemon Juice - 4 tablespoons

Olive Oil - 4 tablespoons

 

Instructions

Take all ingredients in a bowl and mix well. Add in chicken and leave to marinate overnight.

The next day, cook it in a charcoal barbeque grill.

You can cook in regular over as well. Preheat oven to 200 degrees C. Bake for 35 to 40 mins. Remove and broil for 2 to 3 mins.

Serve it.

blogs.title: Tasty Baked Chicken Cream Cheese Dip Recipe
blogs.title_hi: स्वादिष्ट बेक्ड चिकन क्रीम चीज़ डिप रेसिपी
blogs.content:
Delicious chicken cream cheese dip which tastes amazing for parties or get-togethers. This is not only easy to make but taste amazing.

This is a great party recipe. You can make a big batch of it and enjoy it as a dip for parties.

 

Chicken Cream Cheese Dip Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 15 mins

Total time: 25 mins

 

Recipe type: Appetizer

Cuisine: American

Serves: 4 servings

 

Ingredients

Leftover Cooked Chicken - 1 cup shredded

Cream Cheese - ½ cup

Mozzarella Cheese - 1 cup

Mayonnaise - 3 tablespoon

Black pepper - ½ teaspoon

Relish - 1 tablespoon

Spring Onion - 4 tablespoons chopped finely

 

Instructions

Mix all ingredients together, spoon into a baking dish and smoothen the top.

Bake in a 200 degree C. preheated oven for 15 to 20 mins.

Serve it with chips or pita bread.

blogs.title: Chicken Omelette ( Leftover Chicken ) Recipes
blogs.content:
Healthy chicken omelette which is not only delicious but is very easy to make. You can serve it with rice or enjoy on its own.

 

Chicken Omelette Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 5 mins

Total time: 15 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 1 serving

 

Ingredients

Eggs - 3

Cooked Chicken - 1 cup shredded

Onion - 1 sliced thinly

Curry leaves a sprig

Salt to taste

Pepper to taste

Coriander leaves - ¼ cup chopped finely

Oil for making an omelette

 

Instructions

Mix all ingredients in a bowl.

Heat oil in a pan. Pour the mix in and cook for 2 mins on low heat. Flip over and cook.

Serve it hot.

blogs.title: Tasty Cheesy Chicken Fritters Recipe
blogs.content:
This delicious chicken fritter is super easy to make and taste amazing. You can make this in a few minutes and kids will love this for sure.

 

Chicken Fritters Recipe

Prep time: 5 mins

Cook time: 5 mins

Total time: 10 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 2 servings

 

Ingredients

Cooked Chopped Chicken - 1 cup

Carrot - ¼ cup chopped finely

Capsicum - ¼ cup chopped finely

Egg - 1

All-Purpose Flour / Maida - ½ cup

Cheese - ½ cup grated

Water as needed

Salt to taste

Pepper to taste

Oil - for shallow frying

 

Instructions

Mix all ingredients together.

Heat oil in a pan. Spoon some mix in and cook till golden on both sides.

Serve it hot with ketchup.

blogs.title: Tasty Varutharacha Nattu Kozhi Curry Recipe
blogs.title_hi: टेस्टी वरूथराचा नट्टू कोज़ी करी रेसिपी
blogs.content:
The super delicious chicken curry which is not only easy to make but is so yummy. This taste amazing with some rice or roti.

This is a simple chicken curry made using fresh spices and ground coconut. This chicken dish is so easy to make, you need basic ingredients. If you use small chicken pieces then it will be tastier.

 

Varutharacha Chicken Curry Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 45 mins

Total time: 55 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 4 servings

 

Ingredients

Nattu kozhi / Country chicken - 1 kg

Onion - 3 large sliced thinly

Coconut Oil - 4 tablespoon

Fennel seeds / Sombu / Saunf - 2 tsp

Bay Leaf - 1

Cardamom / Yelakai - 4

Cloves / Krambu - 4

Cinnamon / Pattai - 1 stick

Ginger Garlic Paste - 2 tablespoon

Tomatoes - 4 large chopped finely

Chilli powder - 1 tablespoon

Coriander Powder - 2 tablespoon

Turmeric powder - 1 teaspoon

Cumin powder - 2 teaspoon

Garam Masala Powder - 1 tablespoon

Potato - 2 large peeled and cubed

Salt to taste

 

FOR ROASTING:

Oil - 1 tsp

Dry Red Chillies - 6

Coriander Seeds / Malli - 2 tablespoon

Coconut - 1 cup

 

Instructions

Take chicken in a pressure cooker, add salt and turmeric powder and pressure cook for 5 to 6 whistle. Turn off the heat and let it sit till steam escapes.

Heat oil in a pan, add coriander seeds and chillies and saute till toasted.

Add coconut and saute till it gets golden.

Take it in a blender and make it into a smooth paste.

Heat oil in a pan, add whole spices and let them sizzle.

Add ginger-garlic paste and saute for a min.

Add onions and cook till golden.

Add in tomatoes and cook till mushy.

Add spice powders and salt and mix well.

Add in cooked chicken and mix well.

Add ground masala, salt and mix well.

Cook till oil separates.

Serve it.

blogs.title: Tasty Soupy Chicken Curry Recipe
blogs.content:
The delicious soupy chicken curry which tastes so delicious with some hot rice or some Paratha or roti. This can be made using nattu kozhi chicken as well.

This is a simple chicken curry made using fresh spices. This chicken dish is so easy to make, you need basic ingredients. If you use small chicken pieces then it will be tastier. It has a little saucy texture and tastes amazing.

 

Soupy Chicken Curry Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 40 mins

Total time: 50 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 4 servings

 

Ingredients

Coconut Oil - 3 tablespoon

Onion - 2 large

Garlic - 5 cloves

Tomato - 2 large pureed

Turmeric Powder - 1 teaspoon

Chilli Powder - 1 tablespoon

Kashmiri Chilli Powder - 1 tablespoon

Coriander Powder - 1 tablespoon

Cumin Powder - 1 teaspoon

Garam Masala Powder - 1 teaspoon

Salt to taste

Black Pepper Powder - 1 teaspoon

Chicken - 500 grams

Coriander Leaves - 3 tablespoons chopped finely

 

Instructions

Heat oil in a pressure cooker.

Grind onion and garlic till coarse.

Add in onion puree and saute for 5 mins.

Add in the tomato puree and cook till raw smell leaves.

Add in spice powders and salt and mix well.

Add in chicken and mix well.

Add water and cover and cook for 2 whistles for normal chicken and 6 whistles for country chicken.

Take it off the heat and let the steam escape by itself.

Add in pepper powder and coriander leaves.

Serve it over rice.

blogs.title: Tasty Oven Baked ( Juicy Baked ) Fried Chicken Recipe
blogs.title_hi: टेस्टी ओवन बेक्ड (रसदार बेक्ड) फ्राइड चिकन रेसिपी
blogs.content:
Healthy crispy fried chicken which actually tastes like fried chicken. It is healthier and is more juicer than normal ones. Serve it with a side salad and you are good to go.

 

Oven-Baked Fried Chicken Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 45 mins

Total time: 55 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: American

Serves: 4 servings

 

Ingredients

Chicken - 1 whole chicken cut into 10 pieces

Dried Basil - 1 tablespoon

Dried Oregano -1 tablespoon

Cayenne Powder - 1 teaspoon

Garlic Powder - 1 tablespoon

Onion Powder - 1 tablespoon

Salt to taste

Red Chilli Flakes - 1 tablespoon

Oil - 2 tablespoon

Breadcrumbs - 1 cup

Egg - 2

 

Instructions

Take all spices and salt in a bowl and mix well.

Take chicken in a bowl, add half of the seasoning mix in the chicken and mix well.

Take breadcrumbs in a bowl and add the remaining half of the spices in it.

Beat eggs in a bowl.

Take chicken and dip in egg, coat in breadcrumbs and arrange in a foil-lined baking pan.

Drizzle little oil over the chicken.

Pop it in a 200-degree c, preheated oven for 45 mins.

Remove and serve it.
